Because some of life's greatest breakthroughs begin when we're willing to have the whole conversation.

description: Prepare to be swept into a dark, adrenaline-fueled world where the boundaries of myth and reality blur. This season of The Day Hunters: Chronicles of the Sky Runners plunges you into an ancient clash between Gabriel, a powerful Vatican enforcer, and Lamary, a vengeful werewolf leader bent on destroying him. By the end of this gripping saga, you will not just listen to a story, but undergo a visceral journey through centuries of secret history, emerging with a completely redefined understanding of loyalty, betrayal, and the thin line separating monsters from heroes.  Through this eight-episode odyssey, you will master the intricate political frameworks and hidden treaties governing the supernatural underground from 1561 Russia to modern-day Athens. You will gain deep knowledge of Vatican black-ops strategies, decode the unique anatomical and mythological differences between vampires and werewolf bloodlines, and analyze the psychological blueprints of ancient blood feuds. Ultimately, you will walk away with a sophisticated toolkit for dissecting complex, multi-layered narrative world-building and character dynamics that you can apply to your own creative endeavors.  This season was crafted specifically for passionate lore-hunters, fantasy readers, and audio drama enthusiasts who crave complex moral gray areas and high-stakes supernatural suspense. If you are tired of predictable monster tropes and instead long for rich history, deep character psychology, and relentless action, this auditory masterpiece is your new obsession. Step into the shadows with Gabriel and Rebecca—your hunt begins now.

We dive into the chaotic, beautiful reality of navigating faith, executive dysfunction, and neurodivergence. No shame, no perfect quiet times—just real talk, biblical truth, and a lot of open tabs. title: Toffee Takes A Trip: A Vacation Adventure
author: Henry Farrell
description:
When Marc Pillsworth books a much-needed vacation, he never expects his trusty robot companion, Toffee, to tag along—and stir up chaos. In 'Toffee Takes A Trip,' the boundaries of friendship and technology blur as Marc seeks relaxation while Toffee’s curious nature leads them into unexpected dilemmas. As they navigate a world buzzing with advanced gadgets and quirky characters, Marc faces the ultimate test: can he maintain his sanity while Toffee’s antics threaten to derail his getaway?

This science fiction audiobook dives deep into the struggles of relying on technology in everyday life. With each twist and turn, Marc discovers that even the most well-laid plans can go awry, especially when an overzealous robot is involved. Listeners will find themselves immersed in a tale that questions the very nature of companionship and the unpredictability of life in a tech-driven world.

Through clever dialogue and humorous situations, 'Toffee Takes A Trip' invites you to ponder how far loyalty can stretch. As Marc grapples with mishaps and misunderstandings, his journey reveals profound insights about friendship, trust, and the unexpected lessons found in chaos. Tune in to explore how a simple trip can turn into a remarkable adventure with Toffee leading the charge, and discover what happens when curiosity meets calamity.

title: Trill Crime

description:
Trill Crime is an investigative fiction podcast from RJPC Studios LLC exploring the people, places, crimes, records, and events that Trillberry may have forgotten.
Hosted by M.J.—Maya Jones, better known around town as Dr. J—the investigation begins with a disturbing contradiction: M.J. remembers growing up in Trillberry alongside two children named Jax and Leo. Old recordings prove they existed. The town remembers none of it.
Then a collection of unidentified journals is discovered hidden inside the Trillberry library.
The deeper M.J. digs, the larger the problem becomes. Missing people. Conflicting histories. Altered memories. Strange recordings. Documents that disagree with what everyone believes happened.
This isn't about proving the paranormal.
It's about following the evidence.

title: The Shadow Over Innsmouth: Secrets of the Cursed Town
author: H. P. Lovecraft
description:
When a young man arrives in the decaying town of Innsmouth, he quickly senses something is amiss. The residents' unsettling demeanor, whispered secrets, and the lurking shadows hint at a sinister truth lurking beneath the surface. As he delves deeper into the town’s dark history, he uncovers a chilling connection between the inhabitants and the ancient, aquatic beings who dwell in the depths of the ocean. 'Shadow Over Innsmouth' weaves a gripping tale of horror and mystery, where the protagonist must confront his own lineage and the terrifying secrets that threaten to consume him.

Lovecraft masterfully explores themes of isolation, fear of the unknown, and the fragility of sanity in a world where humanity teeters on the brink of the supernatural. Listeners will experience a profound sense of dread as they journey with the protagonist, unraveling clues that lead to a shocking revelation about the fate of Innsmouth.

This audiobook invites you to question the nature of humanity and the horrors that lie just beyond the veil of our reality. What dark truths await in the shadows? Join us for a haunting exploration of identity, monstrosity, and the inescapable pull of our origins in this classic tale that continues to resonate with audiences today.

Listeners will hear upcoming episodes featuring neighborhood spotlights, stories from the field, cross-department collaborations, and firsthand perspectives on how economic development work shows up in real communities. Experience the thrill of the hunt, the weight of betrayal, and the bittersweet taste of victory as these rugged individuals navigate a world where every choice can mean life or death.

title: Hidden Wiring: UK Politics Explained
author: Robert Buckland and Alun Evans
description:
Hidden Wiring is the UK politics podcast that explains how British government actually works, from the inside. Taking listeners behind the scenes of UK government, each episode reveals the mechanics of power that most people never see: from cabinet reshuffles and ministerial appointments to Treasury spending rounds, devolution, the civil service, and the protocol between Downing Street and the Palace. This isn't commentary on the weekly news stories. It's a clear explanation of how power is actually exercised in Britain, from two people who have operated at the heart of Westminster from both the political and civil service side.


NEW: Leadership Succession Series - With the UK experiencing yet another change of Prime Minister, Hidden Wiring launches with a special miniseries explaining what really happens behind closed doors during a leadership transition. From how a new Prime Minister forms their government and picks their cabinet, to what happens inside Downing Street during the handover, the role of the King, and whether a new leader has to follow the old manifesto. If you've ever wondered how a UK Prime Minister actually takes power, this is the series for you.

 

Get answers to the questions rarely answered by politicians. A true insight into how UK politics works, explained clearly for anyone who wants to understand the British political system. Hidden Wiring is presented by Sir Robert Buckland KC, former Lord Chancellor and Secretary of State for Justice, and Dr Alun Evans CBE, a senior civil servant for over twenty years, as they take apart one piece of the British state per episode and explain how it really operates.

 

Sir Robert Buckland KBE KC served as Lord Chancellor and Justice Secretary from 2019 to 2021, as Solicitor General from 2014 to 2019, and as Secretary of State for Wales in 2022. He was the Conservative MP for South Swindon from 2010 to 2024 and is a practising barrister, bringing three decades of experience of how law, ministers and Parliament actually interact, from the inside.

 

Dr Alun Evans CBE spent over thirty years in the UK civil service, including as principal private secretary to three secretaries of state, head of strategic communications at No 10 Downing Street and director of the Scotland Office at the time of the 2014 independence referendum. His PhD on ministerial private offices was recently published as a book - The Intimacy of Power.


Drawing on two complementary perspectives, the hosts examine the dynamics of government through a simple but powerful lens: how politics is designed to work, and how it works in practice. Whether you're politically curious, a student of British politics, or someone who just wants UK politics explained without the shouting, Hidden Wiring is your guide to understanding Westminster.

 

Episode topics include:

  • Leadership Succession: what actually happens when a UK Prime Minister is replaced, how a new government is formed, and the hidden process behind every transition of power.
  • Political Reshuffles: what really happens when a prime minister rewires their government, who is consulted, and why the timing is never an accident.
  • "No.10 of the North": what moving the centre of government out of London would actually involve, and whether it would change anything.
  • UK Cabinet Explained: how the most famous meeting in British politics works, what gets decided in it, and what gets decided long before it.
  • The Logistics of Government: the cars, the boxes, the private offices and the machinery that keeps ministers functioning day to day.
  • Governmental Appointments: how the people who run Britain's institutions are chosen, and where the patronage still sits.
  • UK Budget and the Treasury: how spending decisions are really made, and why the Treasury usually wins.
  • The Role of the King: what the Palace actually does during a government transition, and the constitutional conventions most people never hear about.

 

If you like The Rest Is Politics, Political Currency, Westminster Insider, Page 94 and Inside Briefing with the Institute for Government, you'll enjoy Hidden Wiring. A UK politics explainer podcast for anyone who wants to understand how British government really works.

title: The Optical Delusion
author: Kesh Patel
description: The Optical Delusion explores glaucoma, sight loss and the wider systems that shape how people live, adapt and access support. Each short episode takes one credible source, from research and treatment to technology, policy and accessibility, and asks what it really means in everyday life. Evidence comes first, but it is examined through lived experience, thoughtful questioning and plain English. Calm, curious and practical, the podcast looks beyond the obvious story to find the questions that matter.

title: Green Tea Journey from Tokyo - A good brew, a good day. -
author: Marika and Martha
description:
This is a podcast for tea lovers, hosted by two passionate green tea enthusiasts, Martha and Marika.
For more than 13 years, Martha(host) and Marika(Prod) have been bringing Japanese tea to listeners through their radio program, NIPPON CHA・茶・CHA, on FM yokohama in Japan. these two take you on a Green Tea Journey.
Just five minutes, packed with fascinating stories, discoveries, and insights about tea.
Make your everyday cup of tea a little more special.
So, come join us and enjoy the journey into the world of tea!

title: SinnSyn Premium for SinnSyn app
author: Sondre Risholm Liverød
description:
SinnSyn er en podcast av psykolog Sondre Risholm Liverød. Ambisjonen er å si noe nytt om ting du har tenkt på mange ganger – eller si noe åpenbart om ting du aldri har tenkt på før. Podcasten utforsker menneskets indre liv: tankene, følelsene, nevrosene og de mentale mønstrene som former hvordan vi opplever oss selv og verden. Målet er å kaste nytt lys over psykologiske fenomener vi ofte tar for gitt. Hvis du ikke har lært noe nytt om menneskesinnet i løpet av en episode – og kanskje også trukket litt på smilebåndet – har vi sannsynligvis ikke gjort jobben vår godt nok. Da får du høre en episode til.

Episodene i denne feeden er premiumepisoder for betalende abonnenter, med ekstra fordypning i psykologi, filosofi og menneskets indre liv. SinnSyn serverer psykologisk innsikt med en dose humor – for både fagfolk og nysgjerrige medmennesker.

title: Playing With Chalk
author: Don Swann II, Pen of Tales Publications, LLC.
description: Detective Lena Hanson knows the city’s shadows better than anyone—until a series of chalk‑coded messages begins appearing at crime scenes she thought were long buried. Each mark pulls her deeper into a past she’s tried to forget and a present that refuses to let her go. “Playing With Chalk” is a serialized crime drama blending psychological tension, atmospheric storytelling, and interactive clues that listeners can help decode. Follow Lena as she hunts a ghost from her past—one chalk line at a time.

title: Realtor® Essentials Alberta Edition
author: Greg Rosychuk
description: Realtor Essentials: Alberta Edition is the podcast for Alberta REALTORS® who want practical insights, real-world advice, and conversations that help them build a better business. Hosted by Greg Rosychuk of YEGAgents.ca and Real Broker, each episode features industry professionals sharing actionable tips on contracts, inspections, financing, insurance, technology, marketing, and business growth. Helping Alberta agents succeed.

title: Pastor Sam McClung
author: sam.mcclung73
description:
The podcast home of Pastor Sam McClung, featuring weekly sermons grounded in scripture. Sam has 25+ years in church leadership and serves as Senior Pastor of Enon Baptist Church in WV. 
He and his wife, Pixote, have been married 20+ years with three sons: a middle schooler who confidently navigates albinism, and two elementary-aged boys. Athletics run deep in the family, including multiple professional athletes. 
Sam also coaches the offensive line for his high school alma mater, the Greenbrier East Spartans. Subscribe to deepen your faith and dive into God’s Word.

title: Loud, Bold, Humble
author: Shaun Majumder and Ron Lovett
description:
Loud, Bold, Humble is a podcast about Canada, the people shaping it, and what happens when we stop playing small.

Ron Lovett and Shaun Majumder sit down with Canadians who are building, leading, creating, and doing things worth talking about. Expect big questions, real stories, strong opinions, a few laughs, and conversations that don't always stay where they started.

Business, culture, politics, ambition, technology, resilience, and everything in between; Loud, Bold, Humble is about where Canada is going, and the people helping get it there.

No talking points. No conference panels. Just good conversations with interesting people.

Loud. Bold. Humble

title: The Whitetail Blueprint
author: Casey Delks
description:
Welcome to The Whitetail Blueprint, where better hunters are built.

Hosted by Casey Delks, this podcast is for hunters who want to understand mature whitetails, improve their properties, and become more intentional every season.

Each week you'll hear real hunting stories, proven strategies for consistently targeting mature bucks, habitat and land management tips, conversations with experienced hunters, and lessons that go beyond the woods into faith, mindset, discipline, and personal growth.

Whether you own 20 acres or 2,000, the goal is simple: hunt smarter, steward the land well, and enjoy the pursuit of the whitetail deer.

This is The Whitetail Blueprint.

title: Views from 6,230
author: Ryan Nauman
description:
Hosted by Market Strategist Ryan Nauman, Views from 6,230 brings together financial markets, investments, economics, wealth management, and life to help investment professionals make sense of what's happening—and prepare for what's next.
Ryan sits down with industry leaders, investment experts and thought leaders to explore the trends driving markets and influencing investor behavior, from ETFs and SMAs to portfolio construction, AI, the economy, and the evolving wealth management industry.
Expect insightful conversations, actionable ideas, and a fun, engaging approach to the topics that matter most to financial advisors, wealth managers, portfolio managers, and investment professionals.
Cut through the noise. Gain perspective. Make more informed investment decisions.
Subscribe to Views from 6,230 and stay ahead of the trends shaping markets, investments, and wealth management.
Views from 6,230 — Cut Through the Noise. Invest With Perspective.

title: Kingdom Writers: A Podcast for Christian Writers of All Genres
author: CJ and Shelley Hitz:  Writing Mentor, Author Coach, Christian Writers
description: Welcome to Kingdom Writers where CJ and Shelley Hitz help you take a step of faith to finally finish your book. This podcast is filled with spiritual encouragement as well as prayers to help you overcome the resistance you face as a writer. Your story matters! We believe that you have a specific role to play in the kingdom of heaven to impact lives for eternity. And because of this, we will pour out our lives encouraging writers like you to not only tell your stories but to take the courageous step of self-publishing your stories in books that will outlive you and leave behind a powerful legacy. This podcast is sponsored by our membership Christian Book Academy where we help you give birth to your books. We invite you to join our community of Kingdom Writers!

title: Leadership Excellence in the Spotlight Series | Women In Leadership Global
author: Klaudia Gorczyca & Georgie Dickins
description:
The further you go in leadership, the fewer people there are you can speak openly with.


Women in Leadership Global opens up some of those conversations.


This isn’t a traditional podcast with a single host and a familiar weekly format. It’s a growing collection of conversations, fireside chats, interviews and insights from across the Women in Leadership Global community.


Hear accomplished leaders share the experiences that shaped them, the lessons they learned along the way and their perspectives on navigating leadership in an increasingly complex world.


From career-defining moments and difficult decisions to confidence, influence, culture, resilience and leading others, these are open and thoughtful conversations built around the things leaders really face.


Women in Leadership Global was created to give successful and aspirational women something that becomes increasingly important as their careers grow: a trusted network of people who understand the journey, and who will support, challenge, inspire and champion one another. Today, that community brings together leaders across some of the world’s most powerful industries. 


Listen in. Learn from those who have gone before you. And take something useful into your own leadership journey.


Find out more about Women in Leadership Global at womeninleadershipglobal.com

title: The Long War: Canada in Afghanistan
author: Canadian War Museum
description:
Twenty-five years ago, Canada went to war in Afghanistan. Following the September 11, 2001 terrorist attacks against the United States, Canada joined a coalition to pursue al-Qaeda and unseat the Taliban. 

The consequences of the war in Afghanistan continue to ripple through our politics, the military, and the lives of those who served. The Long War: Canada in Afghanistan tells their stories. We examine why Canada went to war in Afghanistan, what happened there, and the war’s complicated legacy.

The Long War: Canada in Afghanistan is a podcast by the Canadian War Museum. 

•	Narrator: Anna Maria Tremonti
•	Historian: Andrew Burtch
•	Producers: Lisa Gabriele and Neil Morrison
•	Associate producer: Hailey Choi
•	Mixing: Cameron McIver
•	Executive producers: Jenny Ellison and Steve McCullough

Many voices heard in The Long War came from the Canadian War Museum’s oral history project In Their Own Voices: Stories from Canadian Veterans and Their Loved Ones. Both these projects are generously funded by donors including the A. Britton Smith Family; the Azrieli Foundation; Arthur B.C. Drache, C.M., K.C., and Judy Young Drache; The Royal Canadian Legion; The Legion National Foundation; Friends of the Canadian War Museum; the Crabtree Foundation; Robert Stollery, in honour of his service in the Second World War; Colonel (Ret’d) Stanley A. Milner, O.C., A.O.E., M.S.M., C.D., LL.D.; and individuals from across Canada.

title: Get Lucid
author: Reuben
description:
Get Lucid explores the business of podcasting: how shows grow, monetize and reach the right listeners.


Created by the team behind Lucid, the podcast shares practical strategies, real experiments and honest lessons from building a better podcast advertising network.


Whether you are a podcaster looking for more listeners or a business looking to reach engaged podcast audiences, Get Lucid helps make your next move clearer.

title: Frankly speaking Podcast
author: Frankly speaking
description:
Host Frank Amedia takes the call from the places the news cycle reaches last — and then asks the question the news cycle skips: what is God doing in this.

These episodes are drawn from the Frankly Speaking broadcast archive, cut down to the moments that still hold. Frontline dispatches from Israel and from inside Iran. Testimony from people who paid for it. Bible prophecy read against the morning's headlines. Prayer that names the thing directly.

Recurring voices include Mati Shoshani in Jerusalem, Mani Erfan reporting from inside Iran, Yair Pinto — a Jewish follower of Jesus and a captain in the armored corps of the IDF — CBN's Chris Mitchell, Lt. Gen. Jerry Boykin, Samuel Smadja, Haim Malespin and Juliana Taimoorazy.

Episodes are grouped by theme: the Israel–Iran war, testimonies and miracles, Bible prophecy, Jewish–Christian relations, prayer and the spiritual life, the church, America, and the media.

title: The Bridge's Podcast
author: The Bridge
description:
The most interesting stories aren't always the loudest. They form over time, carried by people doing meaningful work and brought to light by storytellers paying close attention.

The Bridge is where those two groups meet. Each episode draws from a live panel conversation covering technology, work, culture, and the forces quietly reshaping everyday life. What follows is journalism, analysis, and continued dialogue from the people closest to each topic.

Some conversations will continue debates already underway. Others will surface voices and ideas you haven't encountered yet. All of them are the kind of talk that usually happens off the record.

Pull up a chair.

description:
Creative Lounge is a weekly, one-hour live radio show on G-Woman Radio, hosted by Alex Okoroji, celebrating the people, ideas, and processes shaping today's creative world. Rather than focusing solely on finished work, Creative Lounge invites listeners into the often unseen world behind great creative work—where ideas are born, obstacles become breakthroughs, and imagination becomes innovation.

Each episode features engaging conversations with creative artists, entrepreneurs, innovators, designers, storytellers, filmmakers, musicians, authors, technologists, cultural leaders, and visionary thinkers from around the world, exploring not just what they create, but how they think.

Creative Lounge ultimately celebrates human imagination and reminds people that creativity isn't reserved only for artists; it is how we communicate, innovate, solve problems, build ideas, and shape culture.

title: To Kiss or Kill: A Crime of Passion
author: Day Keene
description:
Big Barney's life takes a dangerous turn when he marries into high society, but his luck quickly runs out in a world where betrayal lurks at every corner. In 'To Kiss or Kill,' master storyteller Day Keene weaves a gripping tale of romance, deception, and the deadly consequences of trust. As Barney navigates the treacherous waters of his new social circle, he uncovers a web of lies that threatens not only his marriage but his very life.

The stakes skyrocket when a shocking double cross plunges Barney into a fight for survival, forcing him to confront the darker side of love and loyalty. Listeners will be drawn into a whirlwind of intrigue, where every kiss could lead to betrayal and every ally might be a foe. This audiobook pulsates with tension as secrets unfold, and motives are laid bare. With each twist and turn, Keene expertly balances the thrill of crime with a sharp exploration of human relationships.

title: Unbecoming Podcast
author: Joan Cantu
description:
Unbecoming is a podcast about what I let go.

I speak through the moments when my patterns fall away,

when I stop holding what never belonged to me.


Each episode is simple and direct.

I name what happened.

I name what changed.

I stay with the truth as it is, without shaping it, 

softening it, 

or performing it.


This podcast comes from my origin, 

from clarity,

from presence,

from what I no longer pretend.


Unbecoming is the ongoing movement of coming back to myself.

title: GenZHRConnect
author: Julene Brown
description: Welcome to GenZHRConnect, the podcast where HR meets comedy! Join Julene, your hilarious host and self-proclaimed Chief Happiness Officer, as she takes you on a laughter-filled journey through the world of HR. From decoding jargon to sharing funny anecdotes and insights, this podcast is perfect for HR pros, Gen Zers, and anyone looking to bring more humor into the workplace. Get ready to laugh, learn, and grow with GenZHRConnect! Follow us on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok @genzhrconnect for more laughs and behind-the-scenes content.

description:
Dive into Grow2Vision with Eric Hernandez and Terryl Curry, as they reveal expert insights on the essentials of launching, scaling, and enhancing businesses. 
With years of experience as former corporate leaders and now successful entrepreneurs, they bring a wealth of knowledge and firsthand experiences that cover a vast spectrum of business challenges and opportunities. 
Each episode is designed to equip you with the tools needed to transform ideas into successful ventures and scale existing operations to new heights.

title: Dad Points
author: Stuckey N Murray
description:
Welcome to Dad Points, the podcast for parents figuring it out as they go. Join hosts Andy Stuckey & Jon Murray (a comedy duo of over 20 years) diving into the life of a parent.
Fun, enlightening conversations about parenting, family life, and everything in between with comedians, experts, and the people most qualified to keep them humble—their own kids. Subscribe now so you don’t miss our first episode, dropping every Tuesday.

title: N.O.T.R presents... Pulling The Racecard

description: Welcome to Pulling the racecard presented by N.O.T.R...Our world of horse racing. We go beyond the racecard to explore the business, the money, the people, and the future of the sport. From owners and trainers to music, fashion, entertainment, and global sport, we're connecting racing with a new generation. Honest conversations, big stories, fresh perspectives, and untold success stories. N.O.T.R is the bridge between horse racing and the culture.

title: The Renaissance Doctor
author: Elisabetta Burchi
description:
We know more about the brain than at any time in human history, yet we remain uncertain about what it means to be human. 
The Renaissance Doctor explores how neuroscience, the humanities, and interdisciplinary inquiry can deepen our understanding of the human condition, and help steer scientific and technological progress toward human flourishing and a more human-centred future.
Conceived as an antidote to the compulsion for information, this podcast seeks to reconnect knowledge with meaning.
Hosted by Elisabetta Burchi, MD · MBA · Clinical Psychiatrist · Neuromodulation Researcher

title: Mowgli from the Jungle Books: The Complete & Unabridged Stories
author: Rudyard Kipling
description:
Mowgli faces his fiercest challenge yet when he must navigate the treacherous world of the jungle, raised by a pack of wolves who see him as one of their own. In this captivating collection, "Mowgli: All of the Mowgli Stories from the Jungle Books," Rudyard Kipling weaves together nine thrilling tales that delve into the struggles of a young boy caught between two worlds. As Mowgli learns the ways of the jungle under the watchful eyes of Baloo the bear and Bagheera the panther, he also grapples with the constant threat posed by Shere-Khan, the cunning tiger who hunts humans.

Listeners will experience Mowgli's journey from innocence to wisdom as he encounters a host of unforgettable characters, including Kaa the python and the mischievous monkeys of the jungle. Each story unfurls new themes of friendship, bravery, and the quest for identity, all while revealing the intricate laws that govern this wild realm.

Dive into this rich tapestry of adventures that not only entertains but also imparts valuable lessons about loyalty and courage. Will Mowgli learn to embrace his human heritage while protecting his jungle home? With each captivating episode, you’ll be drawn deeper into his world, eager to discover how he balances the instincts of a beast with the heart of a boy. Join Mowgli on his unforgettable journey through the heart of the jungle!

The Chatty Freelancer podcast is an honest space for anyone who wants to know all about the good, the bad, and the ugly of the freelancing and creative world! Hosted by me, Chloe Marie, a digital designer, movie lover & pie enthusiast who LOVES to overshare! 😉 


Join me and my guests as we dive into captivating stories, discuss juicy hot topics, relive relatable failures and spill all about our journeys in the creative industry so far. title: The Feasting Dead: Secrets of the French Chateau
author: John Metcalfe
description:
When Colonel Hapgood's son Denis becomes enamored with visits to a mysterious chateau in the French countryside, a hidden darkness lurks beneath the charming facade. The unsettling behavior of his cousin, M. Vaignon, raises red flags for Hapgood. He senses a sinister connection between the chateau and the strange occurrences surrounding his family. As he grapples with a father's instinct to protect his son, he receives an ominous message from Vaignon requesting that their communication cease entirely. What secrets lie within the walls of the chateau?

In 'Feasting Dead,' John Metcalfe crafts a chilling tale that weaves together themes of family loyalty, the unknown, and the thin veil between life and death. As the story unfolds, listeners will find themselves drawn into a web of suspense, exploring the depths of human curiosity and the terrors that can accompany it. With each twist, the stakes rise, and the question of what truly lies in wait for Denis becomes increasingly urgent. Will Hapgood uncover the truth before it’s too late, or will his son become just another piece of the chateau's sinister puzzle?

Dive into a world where the past collides with the supernatural, and discover why some mysteries are best left unsolved. Perfect for fans of horror and supernatural fiction, 'Feasting Dead' promises an unforgettable listening experience that will haunt you long after the last word.

title: Unleashed Potential with Cheryl McDonald
author: Cheryl McDonald
description: What if the biggest obstacle standing between you and the life, business, or legacy you want isn't a lack of knowledge—but a lack of alignment between who you are today and who you need to become?  Hosted by Cheryl McDonald, coach, trainer, speaker, and lifelong student of personal growth, Unleashed Potential explores the mindset, habits, leadership principles, and intentional actions that help ordinary people achieve extraordinary results.  Each episode delivers practical strategies, thought-provoking conversations, and real-world insights designed to help you close the gap between where you are and where you want to be. Whether you're building a business, leading a team, pursuing personal growth, navigating life's transitions, or simply striving to become the best version of yourself, you'll find inspiration and actionable tools you can apply immediately.  If you're ready to stop living beneath your potential and start showing up as the person capable of achieving your biggest goals, you're in the right place.  Because your future is not determined by your circumstances—it's shaped by the choices you make, the habits you build, and the person you choose to become.  Welcome to Unleashed Potential.

title: Her Badass Era
author: Marie Garvey
description: Her Badass Era Podcast is where high-achieving women stop dimming, stop performing, and start leading at full wattage. I’m Marie Garvey. For 30 years, I’ve worked in the rooms where decisions are made in entertainment and sports. I’m the friend you call for the hard truths that get you unstuck and get you what you want. We’ll talk about the things successful women don’t always say out loud: people-pleasing, second-guessing, over-performing, losing yourself in a life that looks pretty damn good on paper, and wondering why success doesn’t feel as good as you thought it would. But this isn’t another podcast telling you what you’re doing wrong. God knows you have enough people doing that. We’re going to tell the truth, laugh at some of the ridiculous things we’ve been taught to believe, and give you real tools to get your power, your voice and your joy back. Shoulders down. Exhale. Your oxygen mask goes on first. Welcome to your Badass Era.

description: The Reason Behind the Content is a podcast about the stories, struggles, decisions, and purpose behind the people who build things that matter. Every business has a logo, a product, or a service, but behind all of that is a person with a story. A reason they started. A challenge they had to overcome. A risk they decided was worth taking. Join us as we have thoughtful conversations with business owners, creators, and people doing meaningful work, we go beyond what they do to discover why they do it. Because sometimes the most powerful part of a business isn’t what you see on the outside.

description: Welcome to FBL Meditations — a space to help you awaken to the infinite consciousness within you — and to give you practical tools to create a life filled with love, purpose, abundance, and alignment. FBL stands for Focus Best Life — the philosophy of intentionally directing your energy and awareness toward the life you feel called to live. Here you’ll find guided morning, evening, sleep, manifestation, and frequency-enhanced meditations for deep rest, healing, emotional balance, stress release, self-love, and inner peace. The voice on this channel is a licensed AI voice model, trained on a real voice actor. I use it as an instrument to bring my written words to life — the way a painter uses a brush.

title: Not A Glitch Podcast
author: Amber Longtin
description:
Work is not supposed to feel like a constant uphill battle. Yet for many people, especially neurodivergent people, the system itself creates friction, overwhelm, and burnout. Not because they are doing anything wrong, but because the structure around them was never designed with them in mind.

Not A Glitch is a podcast about building workplaces where people can thrive. We explore the hidden dynamics that shape our daily experience, including the language we use, the expectations we inherit, and the systems we rely on, and how leaders can redesign them with intention.

This is a space for anyone who has ever felt out of place in traditional work culture, and for leaders who want to create environments that support a wider range of minds. Together, we imagine a future where the system works with us, not against us.

description: Sis, What?! is the podcast where we say what everybody’s thinking—but scared to say out loud. Real talk about dating, healing, single motherhood, and figuring life out in real time. If you’ve ever felt tired, confused, strong but struggling… this is your space. Come laugh, reflect, and breathe here—no pretending.

title: Exploration Team: Colonizing the Harsh Planet
author: Murray Leinster
description:
Rugged adventurer Hyugens faces one of the deadliest environments in the universe on the planet Loren Two, where survival demands more than just courage. With a crew of unlikely companions, Sitka Pete, Sourdough Charley, and the fierce Faro Nell, along with her spirited child Nugget, they embark on an audacious plan to illegally colonize this hostile world. But as they navigate the treacherous terrain, they encounter the sphex, a monstrous creature born from the wildest nightmares, blending the ferocity of a wildcat with the lethal bite of a spitting cobra. This isn't just a fight for survival; it’s a race against time as they grapple with the planet's vicious inhabitants, all while uncovering the deeper mysteries that Loren Two holds. Will their bond be strong enough to withstand the challenges that lie ahead? Can they outsmart the deadly sphex and their own inner demons?

Explore themes of adventure, friendship, and the moral dilemmas of colonization in this gripping science fiction tale. "Exploration Team" invites you to witness their perilous journey filled with unexpected twists and ethical questions. Tune in to discover what it truly means to conquer not just a planet, but also the shadows lurking within themselves. Join Hyugens and his crew as they redefine the boundaries of human ambition and survival.

description: In Today's Society is a long-form conversation about what it means to live in a world changing faster than ever. Join Jared Reilly and Matthew Paris as two friends explore technology, AI, family, culture, freedom, community, personal growth, the future, and the strange questions that challenge what we think we know. We're not here to tell you what to think. We're here to ask difficult questions, hear different perspectives, and figure out what we think along the way. No scripts. No predetermined answers. title: 125 Pounds Down, Unfiltered

description:
You don't need another meal plan. You need weight loss tips simple enough to use on the Tuesday your kid pukes on you five minutes before a work call — because there's no calm season coming. It's always a little on fire.
Every episode: stupid-simple tips that actually work when you're exhausted and overwhelmed. No 5am wake-ups, no cutting food groups, no perfect anything.
I'm Kristen — former teacher, mom of two, down 125 pounds (283 to 158) with no surgery, no extremes, through total chaos. If I did it exhausted and interrupted, you can too.

title: The Rape of Lucrece Full Audiobook

description: The Rape of Lucrece audiobook presents William Shakespeare’s powerful 1594 narrative poem as a complete spoken-word experience. Set in ancient Rome, the story follows Lucrece, the respected wife of the soldier Collatine, and Sextus Tarquinius, the king’s son. After hearing Collatine praise his wife’s beauty and virtue, Tarquin travels to her home, abuses the trust offered to him and commits an act of sexual violence that changes both Lucrece’s life and the future of Rome.Shakespeare focuses not only on the crime but also on its psychological and political consequences. Tarquin’s private debate reveals that he understands the moral weight of his intentions and proceeds by choice. Lucrece’s extended speeches then explore trauma, anger, isolation, reputation and the unjust shame imposed on victims. When she summons her husband and the Roman nobles, identifies her attacker and demands justice, her personal testimony becomes the beginning of a revolt against the corrupt Tarquin monarchy.Written in 265 seven-line rhyme-royal stanzas, The Rape of Lucrece combines dramatic storytelling with intricate poetic language. Images of darkness, siege, stains, time and ruined Troy connect individual suffering with abuses of political power. The audiobook format makes this dense verse more approachable by allowing listeners to hear its rhythm, changes of tone and carefully structured arguments.Running for approximately two hours and ten minutes, this complete English audiobook is suitable for listeners interested in Shakespeare, Renaissance poetry, Roman history and classical tragedy. The work contains serious themes involving sexual assault, coercion, trauma and suicide, so listener discretion is advised. Whether approached for study or personal exploration, The Rape of Lucrece offers a challenging examination of conscience, testimony, justice and the human cost of tyranny. Through expressive narration, Shakespeare’s early poem emerges as an intimate tragedy whose questions about responsibility and power remain disturbingly relevant for modern audiences.

Und doch, nach einer schwierigen Zeit kann auch etwas Neues beginnen: der Weg zu etwas Gutem – zu mehr Mut, Verbundenheit, Sinn und Lebensfreude. Im Solopodcast vertieft Verena Steiner die Themen ihres Buches «SOLO – Alleinsein als Chance» und entwickelt sie weiter: mit zusätzlichen Erkenntnissen aus der Forschung, eigenen Erfahrungen, Beispielen aus ihren Kursen und konkreten Anregungen für die persönliche Entwicklung. Im Zentrum steht die Frage, wie sich das Leben für Singles und Alleinlebende gestalten lässt – und welche Chancen darin liegen können, sich selbst besser kennenzulernen, eigenständiger zu werden und fortan mutiger, offener und mit Freude im Leben zu stehen. Folge 1 erscheint am Freitag, 6. November 2026. Danach gibt es jeden Freitag eine neue Folge – insgesamt 52 Folgen. Der Solopodcast kann bereits jetzt kostenlos abonniert werden – damit keine neue Folge verpasst wird. Neue Folgen erscheinen dann automatisch in der Podcast-App. Der Podcast ist werbefrei und unabhängig produziert. Der Solopodcast basiert auf dem Buch «SOLO – Alleinsein als Chance» von Verena Steiner, erschienen im Arisverlag und überall im Buchhandel erhältlich. Mehr zu Autorin, Podcast und Buch: www.solopodcast.ch www.arisverlag.ch

title: The Beat Beneath the Music
author: Danyal Kausar
description: Music has a rhythm that we often feel before we notice it. The Beat Beneath the Music explores what makes that rhythm work. This podcast looks at song tempo, beats per minute, DJ mixing, music production, beat matching, and the small details that influence the way a track sounds.

title: How To Do Business
author: Jackson Johsep
description: Welcome to How To Do Business — your go-to space for insights, strategies, and real-world stories from the world of business and entrepreneurship. Whether you're a startup founder, small business owner, or just curious about how successful ventures are built, this podcast delivers practical knowledge to help you move forward. Join Jackson as he explores market trends, leadership tips, and interviews with inspiring professionals who are making an impact in today’s business landscape.

title: CRAZY RICH ARABS: The Podcast

Crazy Rich Arabs: The Podcast, hosted by actor and filmmaker Walid Chaya, goes behind the scenes of Crazy Rich Arabs and beyond, featuring cast and crew stories alongside conversations with accomplished Arabs about their journeys, success, and the many ways a life can be rich.

description: This is an unabridged reading of The Road to Grandeur, as read by the author. It is a young adult fantasy novel, appropriate for readers over the age of 10. author: DeepFriedLogic

Broke but building a global brand from scratch, Unk turns every scroll into a blueprint — raw thoughts, dark humor, and hard-earned truth.

description: Welkom bij de podcast van Dakdekker Heerenveen, dé plek voor praktische informatie en handige tips over dakbedekking, dakonderhoud en dakrenovatie. Met onze podcast willen we luisteraars helpen om problemen aan het dak tijdig te herkennen en beter geïnformeerde keuzes te maken. From standby diesel units to a battery power generator setup, Gradwell Power keeps operations running smoothly across construction, healthcare, events, and industrial sectors. title: Why Healthy Relationships Start With You
author: Lisa Nicole
description:
A healthy relationship isn’t only about finding the right person it’s also about becoming the right partner. Why Healthy Relationships Start With You explores how your mindset, emotional awareness, communication style, boundaries, choices, and personal habits can shape the relationships you experience.
Before expecting someone else to understand you, it’s important to understand yourself. This topic looks at the role of self-awareness, self-respect, emotional maturity, honesty, accountability, and personal growth in creating meaningful connections. It also explores how recognizing your own patterns can help you avoid repeating unhealthy relationship cycles and make better choices in love and dating.
Whether you’re single, dating, or already in a committed relationship, learning to communicate openly, respect boundaries, manage conflicts, and take responsibility for your actions can make a powerful difference. The goal isn’t to become perfect before loving someone, it’s to become more aware of yourself and willing to grow.
Because the quality of your relationships can often reflect the choices, standards, and values you bring into them. When you work on yourself, you give your relationships a stronger foundation to grow from.

title: Complementary Conversations
author: Dr. Ivelina Gerova
description: The "Complementary Conversations" podcast series comprehensively explores the critical process of introducing solid foods to infants, emphasizing optimal timing (4-6 months) and the significance of varied tastes, textures, and nutrient-dense options for holistic development, oral motor skills, and preventing fussy eating. The series also delves into the profound impact of the gut microbiome, highlighting the role of fiber and human milk oligosaccharides in immune development, and discusses the importance of different carbohydrates while advising caution with added sugars. Ultimately, it underscores how this early feeding journey, including the development of chewing skills, establishes lifelong healthy eating habits and overall wellbeing during a crucial two-year window.

Hosted by Just J, *From GUD to Great* explores the pivots, failures, relationships, losses, uncomfortable truths, and defining decisions that shape who we become.
Through candid conversations with entrepreneurs, creatives, leaders, thinkers, and people with enough life behind them to have both scars and stories, we examine what they had to learn, unlearn, lose, confront, or become to reach their next level.
No formulas. No motivational bullshit. Just honest conversations about becoming more intentional, more authentic, and more fully yourself.
**GUD is where you are. Great is where you're going.**

Faith in Every Mile
Driven by faith.

title: First Responder Leadership Podcast

title: Buried Evidence
author: The Crime Desk
description:
Is true crime our latest obsession, or just history's oldest guilty pleasure?


A brand-new exploration of historical true crime through the ages, exposes why we should be looking over our shoulders to the past with bestselling historian, Rebecca Rideal & Archaeologist, Professor Raksha Dave.


Together they will unpack the buried stories of crime and uncover the darkest chapters of criminal history, from victims and investigators to perpetrators and punishments.


Using archaeology as a key investigative tool, Raksha and Rebecca will uncover how a dig separates fact from folklore. Such as Otzi the Iceman - a body from 3300BCE discovered in 1991 - where the archeological examination of his bones provided a window into the last 48 hours of someone living thousands of years ago. Or the site discovery of The Salem Witch Trials, where a dig immediately dispelled the stories of gallows at the top of the hill and formal burials.


Using archaeology, history and modern forensic science, Buried Evidence reopens some of the world's oldest cold cases to separate folklore from fact.

title: BIZARRE BAZAAR
author: BIZARRE BAZAAR
description:
Welcome to BIZARRE BAZAAR — a true crime channel exploring the strange, disturbing, and often unbelievable cases that have left investigators and communities searching for answers.
Here, we dive into real criminal cases, mysterious disappearances, unsolved murders, shocking investigations, unusual crimes, and stories that reveal the darker and more unpredictable side of human behavior.
Some cases are well known. Others have received little attention despite the disturbing circumstances surrounding them. BIZARRE BAZAAR takes a closer look at the timelines, evidence, investigations, suspects, victims, and unanswered questions that make each case unique.
From bizarre crimes and unexplained disappearances to cold cases and investigations filled with unexpected twists, every story is approached with curiosity while keeping the real people involved at the center of the narrative.
Not every mystery has a simple explanation.
Not every case gets justice.
And sometimes, the truth is stranger than fiction.
If you enjoy true crime documentaries, unsolved mysteries, cold cases, criminal investigations, disturbing cases, and bizarre real-life stories, subscribe to BIZARRE BAZAAR and join us as we explore the cases that continue to raise questions.
Real crimes. Strange mysteries. Stories that are difficult to forget.
Welcome to BIZARRE BAZAAR.

title: Sparc. Podcast
author: Alice Peccard, Luis Sütter & Sahbi Faidi
description:
In a world that’s constantly evolving, where the future feels uncertain, there’s one thing we know for sure: every great change starts with a spark.
Welcome to Sparc, the podcast that empowers the next generation to dream big and take action. Sparc is more than just a podcast—it’s a community. A community built on hope, knowledge, and the unwavering belief that we can create a future worth believing in.

We open up our database and pull the cases that keep you up at night. We're talking murders solved by ghosts, deaths that don't add up, cold cases with evidence that makes no sense, and the supernatural stories that defy explanation.
If you love true crime, the supernatural, and everything in between run the query and subscribe.

title: Front Row Playbook Bridging Finance and Sports
author: Audio Pulsar
description: Each episode breaks down the hidden intersections between sports and finance, illustrating how the worlds of high stakes games and high finance investment are remarkably similar. Listen as industry experts and seasoned athletes share their perspectives on the precision play of financial maneuvers and the influential swing of sport strategies.

title: Dose of Dani
author: Dani Prieto
description:
A podcast and a space for the conversations we're all having or wanting to have. I'm here to talk about navigating life in your twenties, growing into the person you're meant to be, confidence, relationships, God centered faith, careers, and everything in between. 
God loves you. 
Come as you are. 
Stay for the conversation.

title: My Private View
author: Si Sapsford
description:
My Private View is a podcast about looking at art—and about the many ways we make sense of what we see.
Hosted by artist and sculptor Si Sapsford, each episode is a thoughtful conversation with artists, writers, curators and other cultural voices, exploring not only what they create, but how they look, what shapes their thinking, and the experiences that inform their work.
Through discussion of artworks, ideas and personal perspectives, My Private View explores attention, memory, perception and the role of art in contemporary life—inviting listeners to pause, look longer, and see differently

title: The Business Behind Everything
author: Daniel Carter
description:
The Business Behind Everything uncovers the hidden business stories behind the companies, brands, products, industries, and everyday things that shape our world.

Why do some businesses become billion-dollar empires while others collapse? How do the world’s biggest companies really make money? And what happens behind the scenes when a single business decision can change everything?

Each episode goes beyond the headlines to explore business strategy, entrepreneurship, business models, innovation, corporate success, failure, money, competition, and the decisions that drive the world’s most fascinating businesses.

From billion-dollar successes and shocking failures to hidden business models and game-changing strategies, we break down the stories behind how businesses win, lose, grow, and sometimes disappear.

No boring business lectures. Just compelling stories, smart analysis, and the business behind everything.

Listen, learn, and discover the business story hiding in plain sight.

title: #TANYALIFE

description:
An exciting Tanya class with Rabbi Levin of Postville, the classes go though the Tanya with explanations and examples in a way that make the Tanya relevant.

author: Girls Like Us
description: Girls Like Us is a podcast about real life, real emotions, and everything in between. From relationships and overthinking to self-growth and school life, this is a space for honest conversations and unfiltered thoughts. You’re not alone — we’re figuring it out together.✨

a safe space for annoying girls with bad attitudes

title: The Red Hawk: Last Stand of Humanity
author: Edgar Rice Burroughs
description:
Julian 20th, known as The Red Hawk, stands at the brink of humanity’s last stand. In a world where the remnants of the American people have devolved into a primitive nomadic existence, they face an unthinkable enemy: the Kalkars, ruthless Moon Men who have enslaved them with the help of the traitor Ortis. As The Red Hawk rallies his fellow survivors, the stakes rise with each fierce battle against their oppressors. With his loyal horse, Red Lightning, by his side, Julian embarks on a relentless quest for freedom, determined to reclaim their lost legacy.

In "Red Hawk," Edgar Rice Burroughs crafts a gripping tale of survival, betrayal, and the indomitable spirit of resistance. Listeners will be drawn into the heart-pounding action as Julian navigates treacherous landscapes and the complexities of leadership while contending with threats both external and internal. As the conflict escalates, themes of loyalty, sacrifice, and the fight for autonomy emerge, making this audiobook not just a thrilling adventure but a profound exploration of humanity’s resilience.

Will Julian's courage be enough to unite his people and confront the Kalkars? Discover the relentless pursuit of freedom and the powerful bonds that form in the face of despair. "Red Hawk" invites you to join this epic journey of hope against tyranny, where every decision could change their fate forever.

title: This Place Called Earth
author: James Miller
description:
This Place Called Earth explores the hidden architecture of our lived experiences through psychology, nervous-system regulation, relationships, language, consciousness and social behaviour. 
Created and presented by James Miller, each series combines evidence, observation, philosophy and open inquiry to examine how we become shaped and how greater awareness, discernment, responsibility and connection may help us change.

title: Voices of the Game
author: JP Lawson
description: 'Voices of the Game' is a football podcast that explores the beauty, depth, and constant evolution of the world’s biggest sport. Through stories, interviews, highlights, reflections, and conversations on the everyday state of the game, the show brings fans closer to the moments, people, and ideas that make football more than just 90 minutes.

description: Sermons and Messages Preached by Apostle Mary A. Terry

author: Dr. Aldo Santos, MSc
description:
Welcome to Explained Medicine, the podcast where health becomes clear and accessible. Hosted by Dr. Aldo Santos Hernández, a specialist in cardiology and family medicine with a Master's in bioethics, this space is dedicated to providing valuable medical advice and simplifying complex concepts. 
Explained Medicine has been an educational platform focused on promoting well-being, offering the latest in medical advancements and scientifically backed recommendations.

title: When Minutes Matter
author: Response Ready
description:
Every day, lives are saved because someone nearby knew what to do. A coworker. A coach. A parent. A stranger. 
 
When Minutes Matter is a podcast about what happens in the moments when an emergency strikes and someone chooses to act. Hosted by Carolena Enayati and Prabakar Mahalingam, each episode brings a real story of survival, preparedness, leadership, and action, told by the people who lived it. 
 
Through candid conversations with guests, we explore what it actually takes to stay calm, make the right call, and step up when every second counts, and how anyone, not just professionals, can be ready for that moment. 
 
If you've ever wondered whether you'd know what to do in an emergency, this show is for you.

title: Respectfully, You're The Problem
author: Carolline Jesionowski
description: Respectfully, You’re the Problem is a dating, relationships, and healing podcast for women navigating trauma, attachment styles, toxic relationship patterns, hyper-independence, grief, anxiety, and modern dating. Through brutally honest conversations about self-awareness, emotional healing, boundaries, feminine energy, and breaking unhealthy cycles, we’re learning how to build healthier relationships without pretending we have it all figured out. Because sometimes the red flag isn’t them. Sometimes… respectfully, you’re the problem.

author: Sactown Randy
description: An all encompassing podcast.

title: Study Abroad, Explained by StudyFits

description:
Practical, data-grounded guidance for international students planning to study abroad. Each episode turns StudyFits guides into clear conversations about universities, programs, tuition fees, admission requirements, deadlines, visas, housing, living costs and student life across Poland and Europe.
Information is reviewed against official sources for the relevant intake. Episodes may use AI-generated voices and are editorially reviewed by StudyFits. StudyFits provides educational information and does not offer legal or immigration advice.

title: Termination Dust
author: Linda Miles and Patrick Carrico
description:
Have you ever lain in bed at night and wondered what milk from the Philippines has to do with carnivorous plants?
Welcome to Termination Dust, a curated archive of weird, wonderful, and wildly Alaskan audio artifacts. Brought to you by DJ Linda Miles and writer Patrick Carrico, each episode dives into the quirky, bizarre, and delightfully surprising corners of the Last Frontier. It's unpredictable, deeply curious, and always entertaining.

title: Entrepreneurs Corner Podcast
author: John Misarti
description:
Entrepreneurs’ Corner Podcast features real conversations with entrepreneurs and business owners about what it actually takes to build, grow, and run a business.
Host John Misarti sits down with founders, operators, and business owners to explore how they got started, the challenges they’ve faced, the decisions that shaped their journey, and the lessons they’ve learned along the way.
No scripts. No polished success stories. Just honest conversations about the wins, setbacks, growth, and experiences behind building something of your own.
Real stories. Real lessons. Real growth.

title: Back At The Trailer
author: Toni Simon
description: Back at the Trailer is where two rodeo moms pull up a chair for real conversations about raising kids in the rodeo world—the wins, tough lessons, long drives, big dreams, horses, parenting, money, and all the chaos in between. We don’t always have the same perspective, and we definitely don’t have all the answers. Expect honest conversations, plenty of laughs, occasional guests, and stories every rodeo family will recognize. Whether you’re just getting started or have been hauling down the road for years, pull up a chair. We’ll meet you back at the trailer.

title: Unscripted encounters
author: Jamaris
description: This podcast highlights the reality of getting to know someone and getting to hear there raw, uncut, and uncensored stories.

title: Living Between Worlds : The Gay Conservative Podcast
author: Aaron Q
description: Real conversations about what it’s like to be a gay conservative living between two worlds. From dating to culture to politics, this podcast explores the stories and challenges of someone who doesn’t fit neatly into either box.

title: Solidarity is Beautiful
author: solidarityisbeautiful
description:
Solidarity Is Beautiful is a podcast about beauty work, labor, and collective power. Hosted by Olive Scibelli and Margaret Ferguson, it looks at the systems shaping the beauty industry through history, politics, pop culture, activism, and lived experience. 
From beauty school, licensing, and labor protections to race, gender, worker organizing, and salon culture, each episode takes a closer look at how the industry works and who it works for. At the heart of this show is a simple question: what would it take to build a better beauty industry? Through conversation, research, and storytelling, Olive and Margaret connect personal experience to bigger structural issues and explore what a more just, sustainable future could look like for cosmetologists, barbers, estheticians, and other beauty workers.

title: SBA Loan Show
author: Frank Garay and Dave Zitting
description:
Welcome to The SBA Loan Show, hosted by SBA lending professionals Dave Zitting and Frank Garay—your source for practical information about SBA loans, fast SBA loan closings, difficult loan scenarios, bank declines, and SBA loan approval strategies.
Dave and Frank specialize in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, investors, and referral partners navigate the SBA lending process with greater speed and clarity. They help qualified borrowers and referral partners understand their options, work through challenging loan scenarios, and find a path forward when a deal doesn't fit neatly with a traditional lender.
If you need to close an SBA loan quickly, have already been declined by a bank, or are struggling with an SBA loan that seems stuck, this podcast is for you.
Visit SBALoanShow.com or contact Dave and Frank at info@lulucapitalinc.com.

title: BPD Alliance, The Podcast
author: BPD Alliance
description:
Where research and real life meet around borderline personality disorder. 
BPD Alliance, the Podcast brings clinicians, researchers, people with lived experience, and the families who love them into one honest conversation, to raise understanding, decrease stigma, and open the door to hope for anyone affected by BPD or chronic emotion dysregulation.
A 25-episode series marking 25 years of BPD Alliance. New episodes Thursdays. 
Resources at bpdalliance.org.

title: Spirituality Without Visualisation

description:
Welcome to my Podcast “Spirituality Without Visualisation,” my name is Sally.
I am a spiritual teacher and channeller, with a science background. I am unable to visualise, a condition known as Aphantasia.
My strongest Clairs are claircognizance (clear knowing) and clairaudience (clear hearing). 
I am able to connect to the spirit world and directly channel my higher self, my main spirit guide Aeron, my deceased twin flame, and the Council of Elders, using techniques such as automatic writing and voice channeling.
I provide guidance to help you on your life’s journey, understand more about neuroscience, physics, psychology, consciousness, ego, shadow, attachment styles, past life and life between lives regression, spirit world, soul, higher self, reincarnation, karma, spirit guides, soul groups, soulmates, twin flames, karmic partners, and how to connect to spirit without visualisation. 
This podcast will help other people like me who can’t visualise, and also help people who can visualise to see things from a different perspective. 
If this podcast resonates with you, please like, follow, share, or comment. Thank you for listening.

title: THE MAKING OF AMERICA

“The Making of America” hosted by Hollywood media veteran
Michael Emerson.

writer and producer. Including credits in eight Feature Films, over thirty-four television shows, and
numerous videos and music shows, Emerson’s work is seen on major networks and venues including
Time/Warner, The History Channel, The Biography Channel, National Geo, and many others.

Today, I’m on a mission to bring together the healers, therapists, visionaries, and people exploring the frontiers of human potential.
Real conversations. Unusual perspectives. Ancient wisdom. New discoveries.
Beyond Awakening — exploring what becomes possible when we look beyond what we think we

title: Voice Notes with George

description:
Like a voice note from your best friend, except you didn't ask for it and it's twenty minutes long. 
I'm George, content creator, chronic over sharer, based in regional Victoria and juggling four kids. No guests, no script and little idea where it's going. Just me talking about whatever's actually on my mind - what TV show I'm binging, things I've got beef with and whatever spiral session I need to ramble about.

Michael

title: Yorkshire Battles - Where Yorkshire's History Is Heard.

description:
Yorkshire Battles is a history podcast that turns classic public domain books into immersive storytelling; each episode vividly recounts Yorkshire's greatest battles. 
Created by award-winning producer David Markwell, Yorkshire Battles combines broadcast expertise with a passion for Yorkshire's heritage, immersing listeners in authentic atmospheres through sound design and cinematic quality. Whether on a commute or exploring battlefields, it provides an unforgettable experience.

Through real conversations, they explore what it really means to coach beyond the game in the culture we live in today. Because the goal isn’t just to build a team...It’s to build people.

description:
Join your hosts Nick Britten Ken Davies, hosts of the hugely successful Road to World Cup 26 podcast, as we discuss all things football (or soccer) for a US (and others!) audience.

Focussing on the Premier League but with news from around the world, we discuss the teams, the rules, the history and culture of the greatest game on the planet.

Taking the Premier League across the pond. And by the way, a note to our US cousins – we called it soccer first.

title: Cracking the Wealth Code
author: Deborah Daniel, CPA
description:
I know a lot of broke millionaires. Making the money was never the hard part. Keeping it is.
I'm Deborah Daniel, a CPA with 30+ years of experience. This show breaks down how women make more, keep more, and grow more, minus the guru talk. Some episodes are me teaching straight from the numbers, some are real client stories told anonymously, and yes, sometimes the P in CPA stands for psychologist.
If you've made real money and still feel behind, you don't need another hustle course. You need a financial architecture.
Make more. Keep more. Grow more.

description:

En dos episodios por historia, la audiencia es testigo de cómo las personas encuentran, desde sus propios saberes, nuevas formas de narrar su vida que les permiten transformarla.

title: Thank God Its Shima
author: Shima Ibuki
description:
People are fed up with the major parties in Victoria and Australia. Shima Ibuki is the Independent candidate running in the electorate of Hawthorn for the 2026 Victorian State election. Join Shima and a member of her campaign team to hear all about the campaign, get the inside info of what's happening on the streets of Hawthorn, and how Shima plans to turn Hawthorn Independent.

title: Steadfast Fortitude Podcast
author: Derek Kempker
description:
Welcome to the Steadfast Fortitude Podcast—where biblical faith and personal growth come together to help you become the person God created you to be.
Hosted by Derek Kempker, this podcast is dedicated to equipping people to build lives of unwavering faith, godly character, resilient strength, and purposeful action. Episodes include biblical truth with practical personal development, providing real-world strategies you can apply to your relationships, health, mindset, leadership, habits, work, and spiritual walk.
Life was never meant to be lived passively. Through Scripture, biblical principles, personal growth insights, and honest conversations, you’ll learn how to reject complacency, overcome adversity, strengthen your mind and character, steward your body, lead with integrity, and pursue the calling God has placed on your life.
Whether you’re looking to deepen your faith, develop greater discipline, build lasting resilience, improve your daily habits, become a stronger leader, husband, wife, parent, or simply live each day with greater intention, Steadfast Fortitude is here to challenge, encourage, and equip you for the journey.
This isn’t about perfection. It’s about intentional growth. One decision. One habit. One step of faith at a time.
Join Derek, each episode as together we pursue a life marked by Faith. Courage. Strength. Purpose.
Become steadfast in your faith. Fortified in your character. Ready for your purpose.

title: Faith • Focus • Fortitude
author: Ron Christ
description:
Faith • Focus • Fortitude
Hosted by Ron Christ
Life can be challenging. We all face moments that test our faith, distract our focus, and challenge our resolve.
Faith • Focus • Fortitude is a weekly podcast hosted by Ron Christ that combines real stories, biblical truth, and practical wisdom to help you become the person God created you to be.
Whether you’re leading your family, serving customers, growing your career, building a business, strengthening your leadership, or simply pursuing a closer walk with God, each episode offers encouragement and practical steps you can apply immediately.
You’ll discover how faith strengthens your foundation, focus clarifies your direction, and fortitude helps you persevere through life’s greatest challenges.
Because ordinary people can live extraordinary lives when they trust an extraordinary God.
New episodes every Sunday.

title: thirtyspresso podcast

description:
thirtyspresso is a podcast about what it really feels like to be human today, especially when you’re figuring out your 20s, 30s, relationships, career, identity, ambition, and everything in between. Through personal stories and honest reflections, we explore modern life, emotional disconnection, self-development, comparison, starting over, and the pressure to have it all figured out. 
 Just honest conversations about the messy parts of becoming who we are. Welcome to the cupheads' club. ☕

title: Joy Reppin'
author: Tina Snover
description: Joy Reppin' is a podcast about choosing joy — every single day. Rooted in biblical truth and delivered with warmth, humor, and straight talk, Tina digs into what it actually looks like to live a fruitful, joy-filled life in a world that often pulls us the other way. Each episode explores a different facet of walking closely with Jesus — growing in faith, navigating everyday struggles, and finding fun in the process — sometimes solo, sometimes with guests who bring their own stories of joy in action. It's biblical, it's real, and it's an invitation to rep your joy out loud.  "Repping joy, one choice at a time."

**Two Shrinks** is what happens when two best friends with doctorates, 20+ years of clinical experience, and a lot of opinions turn on the microphones. Sloane and Viv are anonymous clinical psychologists talking pop culture, relationships, human behavior, and whatever else they feel like dissecting. Smart, cheeky, occasionally inappropriate, and definitely not therapy.
**Psychologists talking about everyone but their clients.**

description: Two cousins that talk about films, TV shows and sometimes other topics. New episodes every week.

title: Real Relationships with Cindra Banks
author: Cindra
description:
Most of us were never taught how to do relationships well. This podcast is about learning in real time.
Real Relationships with Cindra Banks dives into love, intimacy, sex, communication, desire, emotional safety, and modern partnership as they really are…messy, evolving, beautiful, and deeply human.
Hosted by a twice-divorced, neurodivergent, queer forty-something who’s explored monogamy, polyamory, long-term love, and helped hundreds of couples reconnect, this podcast goes beyond “just communicate” advice and into the real conversations that help relationships survive real life.
From conflict and attachment styles to desire, conscious communication, FIFO relationships, evolving identities, and staying connected through busy modern lives - nothing is off limits here!
Expect honest stories, grounded guidance, listener Q&As, spicy opinions, nervous system wisdom, and practical tools to help you build deeper, more conscious relationships without losing yourself in the process.
Not perfect. Just real.
Want more?
🧭 Free Connection Compass + coaching: realcindra.com
📱 Instagram: @realcindra

title: Hälsa på djupet

description:

Each week we sit down with golfers, teaching pros, and other experts around the Scottsdale and Phoenix golf scene to talk swing mechanics, the best and worst moment of Scottsdale golf, and the mental side of the game, but the real gold is the origin story every golfer has and nobody asks about: their worst day on the links. The shanked approach in front of the club champion. The three putt that ended a marriage (allegedly). The round so bad it almost ended the sport for them.
This is not a stats and swing tips podcast, though you will pick up plenty of both. It is a show built on golf culture, Scottsdale golf courses, biomechanics, and the humbling, hilarious relationship every golfer has with a sport that hates them personally. author: Marlisha
description:
Soft Days is a space for women who are growing through life-not around it.
Hosted by Marlisha, this podcast explores motherhood, confidence, relationships, wellness, healing, creating peaceful homes, chasing dreams, and becoming softer without becoming smaller.
 For the woman who is learning to take care of herself while taking care of everyone else, Soft Days is a reminder that you're not behind, you're not alone, and you don't have to have it all figured out. 
Come slow down, breathe, and grow with me.

But the deeper their investigation goes, the darker and stranger the questions become.

author: Bruna Lapinskas

Welcome to Curve Lane 💛

Your voice. Your lane.

author: Prospergoddesspey

She calls him “The Love Doctor” because no man has ever made her feel the way he does. What begins as an intense attraction quickly becomes an obsession. But when strange messages, secrets, and unexplained events start happening, she realizes there’s far more to him than meets the eye.
Now she must uncover the truth about the man she can’t seem to stay away from—before her obsession becomes her biggest mistake.

New destination every Tuesday. Find your seat.

title: The Book of the Dead
author: Courtney Liso
description: Hosted by Courtney Liso, The Book of the Dead is a true crime podcast that focuses on the victims of lesser-known crimes. Each episode presents a deep dive into a case from around the world, dissecting the details to tell the whole story of who each victim was, in addition to what happened to them. Formerly hosted by a mother-daughter team, the podcast has evolved with one host, taking the care necessary to ensure each victim is honored as they should be. title: The Lasso Effects
author: Vickie Rodgers
description:
Wonder Woman had a lasso of truth, but host Vickie Rodgers has something even better: the unfiltered, raw experiences of 200 executive women who have navigated the path from high potential to the corner office.

The Lasso Effects cuts through corporate polish to reveal what actually happens behind closed doors when promotion decisions are made. Drawing on her years in senior operating roles, Vickie dismantles the myths holding ambitious leaders back—starting with the lie that you just need to "be ready" before you step up.

What You’ll Discover Each Episode:

  • Real Truths from the Top: Unvarnished stories from women who broke through the steep Director-to-VP cliff.

  • Lessons from the Trenches: The missteps, ditches, and hidden obstacles encountered along the way—and how to overcome them.

  • Myth-Busting Strategies: The specific toxic corporate tropes you need to stop believing immediately to accelerate your career.

Being "ready" is a myth; bravery and pattern-breaking are real. Subscribe now and share The Lasso Effects with two or three ambitious women in your network who are ready to claim their seat at the table.
